name: 2026-10-13-rental7-skew-gh200
design: design-r7 DESIGN.md corrected by design-r7-review REVIEW.md (a)-(h) (the review wins) and the owner's decisions of 2026-10-13 (1 S_med plus the run guard, P20 printed beside; 2 Q1-H rivals scored apart from the copies clause; 3 the l2open byte page in, C 60 MiB, the 5% clause on skewed rows; 4 no second-K rerun; 5 fresh seeds on the same treads)
tool: scorer scripts/scoring/rental7/score_skew.py; predictions reg6.priced via reg7.py (model v3 unchanged); histograms scripts/skew_synth7.py --draw7
model: docs/registered/2026-10-09-rental6-v3-gh200.json (model v3, unchanged; no term added); every cell carries v2, v3, v3_nob, v3_noca, LT3, v3_all and H8 (ms)
what: the certification rental 6 could not give: Mixtral and Phi in CLEAN, on fresh draws at rental 6's treads, under the drift rule of rental7-g1rule

histograms.synthetic: SYNTHETIC: rental 6's rule exactly (skew_synth.pages6), seed base 20261020 instead of 20261010: seed = 20261020 + 1000 x shape index (rental 6's: Mixtral 0, OLMoE 1, Phi 2) + 10 n + label index (PT 0, PW 1, DW 2, PW2 3), so seed(n) is rental 6's seed(n + 1); shuffle seed 20261020 (owner decision 5: fresh seeds, same treads)

leakage.key: a cell is published when a published page or an earlier registered histogram file carries the same (model, n, counts sha256)
leakage.note: the controls' counts are rental 6's; only the uniform cells' token-row shuffle moves (content keys)

cells.common: R3's tile 32x64x64 w8 s4 at G = 8; NATIVE and SHARED at 9 copies (not vLLM's tile: nothing here is the working bar on vLLM's tile)
cells.n_stratum: G3's stratum is the tread's rank within its shape
cells.count: 120 cells, 84 E1 cells (skewed and uniform); 120 pass the host rule

gates.G1_lock_thermal: rental7-g1rule: the scorer rebuilds the page from its cells.csv under r7-median-run3 (R3's stored G1 and medians are never read); a page whose cells.csv counts differ from its report, or that did not run --slip-policy cell --min-clean-repeats 0, is NOT SCORED; a page failing the rebuilt G1 counts in ALL and is dropped in CLEAN (rental 2's rule 3)
gates.repeats: a cell is VALID with at least 6 clean repeats of its timed repeats under r7-median-run3 (R3 times all 9: min-clean 0); its time, clock and host flag are the scorer's medians over its clean repeats
gates.G2_host_bound: rental 3's registered host rule (T_v3 + F240 >= 0.40 ms on the REGISTERED prediction) AND the page's timer flag host_bound
gates.G4_cell_clock: the cell's clean-repeat median clock at least 1705 MHz, else the CELL is dropped
gates.G5_provenance: as rental 6: histogram file sha256, every row's counts_sha256, bincount_ok, the shuffle seed; else NOT SCORED
gates.G3: rental 5's text verbatim (rental 6's, with delta_v3), clusters = the six pages (df 5)
gates.G3_void_all: rental 6's owner decision kept: a G3 FAIL with Q not rejecting voids every histogram cell; E1 printed DESCRIPTIVELY on the voided cells
gates.no_report: a page with no report.json or no cells.csv is NOT SCORED; the scorer reads both (cells.csv for every repeat, the report for provenance, lock_mhz and repeat_rows)
gates.views: ALL and CLEAN (rental 2's rule 3); the registered verdict holds only if both views hold
gates.p20_view: DESCRIPTIVE: every test re-read on the P20 rebuild (its own medians, clocks, lost cells and G1 with the 20% ceiling), printed beside

E1-SKEW.statistic: e = T_v3 / T_meas - 1 (T_v3 the registered prediction carried to the page's own A) over every valid histogram cell (PT PW PW2 DW uniform)
E1-SKEW.rule: HOLDS iff the POOLED valid cells meet rms <= 2%, max |e| <= 5% and |mean e| <= 1%, AND each shape's valid cells meet the same bar (the new per-shape clause), in each view; the registered verdict holds only if both views hold
E1-SKEW.certification: a shape is CERTIFIED in CLEAN iff its CLEAN cells meet the bar and at least 2 of its 3 pages are in CLEAN; with fewer it reads NOT CERTIFIED
E1-SKEW.on_G3_void_all: NOT SCORED; E1 printed DESCRIPTIVELY on the voided cells

E1-rivals.rule: rental 5's: a rival is EXCLUDED if its rms on its registered lever cells is at least 2x v3's there and at least 0.76%; UNDECIDED below 6 surviving lever cells
E1-rivals.term_b: rental 7 does not test term (b) on time: (b) moves no E1 cell past 0.54% on these shapes; Q1-H is (b)'s test

SKEW-RATIO.statistic: r = T(h) / T(uniform), same page, n and arm; e = r_v3 / r_meas - 1
SKEW-RATIO.rule: rental 5's: HOLDS if rms <= 1.5% and max |e| <= 4%; LT3 and U by the rival rule on their ratio lever cells

power.model: mc7 block B (design-r7) with the review's per-shape clause (work/mc_e1_shape.py): e = scale x mu(model, n, arm) + a per-model board shift + cell noise; mu and the cell sd SEEN from rental 6's Mixtral and Phi pages (ALL view, rental 6's scorer functions): sd_cell 0.233474% over 80 cells

labels.mixtral-8x7b: skewed: BLIND draws, BLIND-CALMODEL; uniform and balanced: SEEN replicates
labels.phi-3.5-moe: skewed: BLIND draws; uniform and balanced: SEEN replicates; Phi carries Mixtral's shapes (rental 6 owner decision 4); h SEEN-FITTED, but no rental-7 cell is IN-SAMPLE for h (OLMoE is not timed)
labels.rental6: rental 6's verdicts stand and its pages are SEEN

scorer_ambiguities.1 the registered rule and where it runs: r7-median-run3 (S_med plus the run guard, owner decision 1), applied by the scorer to cells.csv (r7common.rebuild); R3 is unchanged and runs --slip-policy cell --min-clean-repeats 0; a page that ran another min-clean is NOT SCORED
